author: Fextralife
description:
Nioh 3 REVIEW - 100% Completed & 100% Satisfied (PC & PS5)
In this Nioh 3 Review, we're going to be taking a deep dive into the latest Team Ninja title and my most hyped game of the year so far, Nioh 3. Over the past six years, we've been seeing Team Ninja experiment outside their traditional comfort zone from Ninja Gaiden and their original Nioh game with Wo Long, combat was much more streamlined and built around parrying. While the Rise of the Ronin mark Team Ninja's first true open world experience, which we reviewed as a solid first attempt back in 2024. Now with Nioh 3 we can finally see that experimentation culminating into a grand ambitious Nioh title as the series first open world, time travelling titme. So After playing 100 hours and getting 100% achievement in the game. Can I confidently say they struck the landing on their most ambitious project yet and kept the incredibly high standard that Nioh 2 had set back in 2020? Let's find out.
